content.english: O Lord of all created things, who is noble in His splendor,

content.hebrew: הַמֵּנִֽיעַ פַּלְכֵי רוּם, וְלֹא מִשְּׁשָׁם יָדוֹ.
content.transliteration: Hammeni’a‘ palkhē rum, velo mish’shesham yado.
content.english: Who moves the heavenly regions without touching them.
He reveals mysteries, and who knows His secret?
Light dwells with Him, and there is nothing aside from Him.
He chose the father of a multitude, His beloved,
And took him out of Ur Kasdim, and made his footsteps straight,

content.transliteration: Ki ibbad tsalmē sekhiyya bekhol me’odo
content.english: For he had destroyed the crafted idols with all his might.

content.hebrew: פְּרִי פִיו עֵץ חַיִּים, וְלֹקֵֽחַ נְפָשׁוֹת בְּלִמּוּדוֹ.
content.transliteration: Peri piv ‘ets ḥayyim, veloḳe’aḥ nefashot belimmudo.
content.english: The fruit of his mouth was a tree of life, and he acquired souls through his instruction.

content.hebrew: וְהָפְרַע פָּרַע מוּסָר, רָאוּ עֵינָיו פִּידוֹ,
content.english: Hofra‘ suffered rebuke, and his eyes saw his [own] destruction,
For he had set his hand on [Abraham’s] bosom wife.
And in the morning, he beseeched [Abraham], and told him of his sufferings.

content.transliteration: Uvehiḳḳavets ḥameshet nesikhim, kol ish behit‘attedo,
content.english: When the five princes gathered together, each one being prepared,
[Abraham] unsheathed [his weapons for] his retainers, and rescued Lot, who was dear to him.

content.hebrew: וּמַלְכִּי־צֶֽדֶק בֵּרְכוֹ לְאֵל עֶלְיוֹן אֲשֶׁר סְעָדוֹ,
content.english: And Melchizedek blessed [Abraham] unto El ‘Elyon, who had helped [Abraham],
content.comments: El ‘Elyon. A name for God; traditional English: “the most high God.”

content.english: And had delivered his enemies, and all who would plunder him, into his hand.

content.hebrew: הָיָה דְבַר יוי אֵלָיו בַּמַּחֲזֶה לְהַפְקִידוֹ,
content.transliteration: Haya devar Adonai elav bammaḥazē lehafḳido,
content.english: Adonai’s word came to [Abraham] in a vision, to instruct him,
To inform him and tell him the secret of the end-times;
[When] a deep sleep fell upon him, to make him tremble.

content.hebrew: תָּמִים קְרָאוֹ, וּבְמָסֽוֹרֶת הַבְּרִית הֱבִיאוֹ, חוֹתַם עֵדוֹ.
content.transliteration: Tamim ḳera’o uvmasoret habberit hevi’o ḥotam ‘edo.
content.english: [God] called him unblemished, and brought him into the tradition of the covenant, the seal of His witness,
And [He instructed him] to distance the handmaiden and her son from Isaac, to separate him—
content.comments: The handmaiden and her son. Hagar and Ishmael.

content.hebrew: כִּי בְיִצְחָק לְבַדּוֹ יִקָּרֵא זַרְעוֹ לְהָלִיץ בַּעֲדוֹ.
content.transliteration: Ki veYits’ḥaḳ levaddo yiḳḳarē zar‘o lehalits ba‘ado.
content.english: For in Isaac alone will [Abraham’s descendants] be called his progeny, such that [Abraham] can advocate for [his offspring].

content.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה תִּפָּקֵד עֲקֶֽרֶת הַבַּֽיִת בְּבֵן יַקִּיר, אֱלֹהִים חֲמָדוֹ –
content.transliteration: Vehinnē tippaḳed ‘aḳeret habbayit beven yaḳḳir, Elohim ḥamado –
content.english: Behold, the barren woman of the house will be taken account of with a dear son, whom God loves—
content.comments: The barren woman of the house. Sarah.

content.english: [All this] He announced to Abraham, his pious man.

content.hebrew: וַיָּֽמָל יְלִיד בַּֽיִת וּמִקְנַת כֶּֽסֶף בְּשָׁקְדוֹ,
content.transliteration: Vayyamol yelid bayit umiḳnat kesef beshoḳdo,
content.english: He circumcised all born in his house, and all [the slaves whom he had] acquired with silver, diligently;
He did God’s will, and served him with his whole heart.
His heart rejoiced, and his soul was glad.

content.hebrew: קהל: אָב לְבָנִים יוֹדִֽיעַ אֲמִתּוֹ וְיֵיחוּדוֹ.
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Av levanim yodi’a‘ amitto viyeḥudo
content.english: Cong. The father informed his children of His truth and oneness.

content.hebrew: חזן: חַ֥י חַ֛י ה֥וּא יוֹדֶ֖ךָ כָּמ֣וֹנִי הַיּ֑וֹם אָ֣ב לְבָנִ֔ים יוֹדִ֖יעַ אֶל־אֲמִתֶּֽךָ: (ישעיהו לח:יט)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Ḥai Ḥai hu yodekha kamoni hayyom av levanim yodi’a‘ el amittekha:
content.english: Cantor: Each and every living thing will acknowledge You, like me, today; [every] father will inform his children of Your truth. (Isa. 38:19)

content.hebrew: חַי־֖יו֖י וּבָר֣וּךְ צוּרִ֑י וְ֝יָר֗וּם אֱלוֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִֽי: (תהלים יח:מז)
content.transliteration: Ḥai Adonai uvarukh tsuri veyarum elohē yish‘i:
content.english: Adonai lives, and my Rock is blessed; and may the God of my rescue be lofty. (Ps. 18:47)

content.hebrew: רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יוי אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְ֭הִֽשְׁתַּֽחֲו֖וּ לַֽהֲדֹ֥ם רַגְלָ֗יו קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא: (תהלים צט:ה)
content.transliteration: Romemu Adonai elohenu vehishtaḥavi lahadom raḡlav ḳadosh hu:
content.english: Declare the loftiness of Adonai our God, and prostrate yourselves to his footstool—holy is He! (Ps. 99:5)

content.hebrew: קהל: קָד֧וֹשׁ ׀ קָד֛וֹשׁ קָד֖וֹשׁ יו֣י צְבָא֑וֹת מְלֹ֥א כָל־הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ: (ישעיהו ו:ג)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ḳadosh, ḳadosh ḳadosh Adonai tseva’ot melo khol ha’arets kevodo:
content.english: Congregation: Holy, holy, holy is Adonai Ẓeva’oth; the entire world is full of His Glory. (Isa. 6:3)
content.comments: Adonai Ẓeva’oth. A common name for God in Scripture; traditional English: “the Lord of Hosts.”
